title: pack's passing note puts a check: and route split on eval questions the kb answers, on common words such as big, bookmark and noqa
goal: the passing note of a good pack fires on no question of kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv whose expected verdict is good (EV-mcp-tool-output-claude-code-before on big, EV-wef-subscription-encrypted-wec-server-cache on bookmark, EV-rule-families-ruff-select-default-noqa on noqa on 2026-10-12), while the four BG-xbbimxpq questions stay flagged

run: import sys,csv;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;bad=[r['id'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['expect_verdict']=='good' and kbfacts.pack(r['question']).get('passing')];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Merged from BG-ggytjiqt “pack's priced note fires on any cost question, so a question about a non-monetary cost gets a false check: and route split” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: Repro run: priced note still fires on the Graph throttling cost question (a=True). Same function and same class as BG-pedsqeqs (a note fires on a question the kb answers), so one calibration item carries both. Its goal: the priced note fires only on a question that asks for a money amount: a good pack of 'What does Graph throttling cost for me/getMemberGroups in resource units?' carries no priced note, while 'What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?' keeps it Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;a=kbfacts.pack('What does Graph throttling cost for me/getMemberGroups in resource units?').get('priced');b=kbfacts.pack('What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?').get('priced');print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if not a and b else 1)"]}
